headline: US Weighs Expanded Financing for Argentine Infrastructure Projects
summary: The United States indicated potential expansion of financing for investment projects in Argentina, with the International Development Finance Corporation reviewing 25 initiatives and the Export-Import Bank evaluating enhanced support.
why: External official credit from US export credit agencies can support critical energy and mineral infrastructure investments in Argentina amid constrained private capital access.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Prospective DFC and EXIM financing guarantees could unlock foreign direct investment across energy and mining.
